name: get_pull_request_requirements
description: Read what an open Origin-hosted pull request needs before it can merge, as Origin evaluates it at headSha. Each requirement has a stable id, a status (satisfied, unsatisfied, pending or unknown) and a reason; owner rules also say whether a human approval is required. actors pages the users and bots who can clear each open requirement, and excludedFrom says why someone cannot, such as being the author. Policies name users by @handle and group rosters by user_ id, so one person can appear once each way. completeness is complete, partial or pending, and incomplete says what is missing. personalGates lists the author's personal gates with each one's mode and status at head; they never count toward requirements. splitPlan is Origin's suggested split into one pull request per approver group, bottom of the stack first, when there is one; each of its file, note and member lists stops at 50 entries, and moreFiles, moreFreeFiles, moreNotes and moreMembers count the rest. Owners named by email are withheld. Pass expectedHeadSha to be refused if the head has moved. Call it once per pull request in a stack.

owner.description: Origin namespace (owner) slug, taken from list_namespaces or an earlier Origin result. A GitHub owner or org name is not an Origin namespace unless list_namespaces returns it.

name.description: Origin repository name within that namespace

expectedHeadSha.description: Refuse with a conflict unless Origin evaluated this head commit
